note: Authored fixtures, not run. Each file lists the functions it exercises (calls), inputs and the expected result. Synthetic: they never certify current capabilities, and the fake provider never counts as a real generation. Tokens like $CANON_DIGEST:<key> are resolved by the future runner from the named identity file. Plan 14 runs the real clips, scenes and (when approved) a configured provider.
